title: Kicks On Route 66
description: Kicks on Route 66 is a high-energy Scottsdale retreat built for connection and unforgettable group stays. This mini-resort features 8 bedrooms, 5.5 baths, two living spaces, and nonstop fun. Enjoy a private bowling alley, arcade, pool table, foosball, and a Route 66 Treasure Hunt with a real prize. Outside, relax by the heated pool option, hot tub, fire pit, and outdoor kitchen. Perfect for families, friends, and group getaways.
review_snippets: This home is a guest favorite based on ratings, reviews, and reliability

So spacious and super cute! Perfect for a bachelorette party with 17 girls. Had great amenities. Host was nice and friendly. Also accommodating. I have no complaints at all. Would definitely recommend a visit with your fave group of ppl!

Leslie was a great and responsive host! The house has so much to do! You do not have to leave. Lots of space and beds which was great for our large group. Very close to a grocery store and restaurants too. Would recommend and stay here again!

Leslie’s place was perfect for our get together. She was extremely responsive and helpful with any questions. We feel she went above and beyond to make sure we had a good stay. Would recommend her to anyone wanting a great stay!

Our stay was nothing short of wonderful. Leslie is a fantastic host who is both professional and genuinely caring; her communication was seamless and very prompt. We were so touched by the welcome basket and her kindness in allowing us a late checkout. Her hospitality really elevated our entire vacation experience. Definitely would stay here again!!

Leslie was very accommodating.  Everything in the kitchen was very well laid out and actually labelled so you don’t have to open every drawer and cabinet looking for things.  The backyard is beautiful and spacious.  Another amazing feature was everyone could take a shower from every bathroom at the same time and there was plenty of HOT water.   Highly Recommend!!!!!
Great house, and great location! Leslie was great throughout the whole process, highly recommend!
